name: Islands Archive 🌴 [BETA]
desc:
Welcome to the Islands Archive! This is a recreation of the old version of the game Islands.

To obtain the VIP gamepass, buy the gamepass from the official Islands store.

🌲 Build your own island
👨‍🌾 Create huge farms
💸 Sell items to make money
🍳 Cook tasty delicacies
✨ Gather valuable resources
🔥 And more!

Update Log (May 2):
Factory blocks! Conveyors, Auto smelters, ovens and more!
Combat (Swords!)
Chests
Slime Island
Eat food to regain health
Coin bags for trading with players
Drop items on mobile
Bug fixes for days

No Robux is being made off of this game. This game is merely a passion project.
Play the official game here: https://www.roblox.com/games/4872321990/Islands

🛑 WARNINGS: 
- Progress may reset during Beta testing.
- By playing this game, you understand that the easy.gg team may shut this game down at anytime. If that is the case, no reuploads will be made.
duping = reset / ban if repeated offenses.
